app.title: Show HN: AgentRun – open-source, Self-improving Managed Agents
app.description: A framework for building self-improving, managed AI agents that can learn from experience and adjust their behavior over time.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and install dependencies via pip
Run the provided example agent with a simple task and verify it completes
Measure the agent's runtime latency for a standard prompt
Test the self-improvement hook by simulating a feedback loop and ensuring policy updates are persisted
